title: A proper morphism is a limit of proper morphisms over schemes of finite type over Z
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a proper morphism of schemes [def-weil-proper-morphism] with $S$ quasi-compact and quasi-separated [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Then there are a directed set $\Lambda$ and an inverse system $(f_\lambda:X_\lambda\to S_\lambda)_{\lambda\in\Lambda}$ of morphisms of schemes (transition morphisms $X_\lambda\to X_\mu$, $S_\lambda\to S_\mu$ for $\lambda\ge\mu$, commuting with $f_\lambda,f_\mu$) such that: the transition morphisms $X_\lambda\to X_\mu$ and $S_\lambda\to S_\mu$ are affine [pqf-def-affine-morphism]; every $f_\lambda$ is proper; every $S_\lambda$ is of finite type over $\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Z$ [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]; and $(X\to S)=\varprojlim_\lambda(X_\lambda\to S_\lambda)$, i.e. $X=\varprojlim_\lambda X_\lambda$ and $S=\varprojlim_\lambda S_\lambda$ in the category of schemes [lem-weil-pbc-limit-affine-transition], with $f$ the limit of the $f_\lambda$. If moreover $S=\operatorname{Spec}A$ is affine, the system can be chosen with every $S_\lambda=\operatorname{Spec}A_\lambda$ affine, $A_\lambda$ a finitely generated $\mathbf Z$-algebra (generated as a ring by finitely many elements); then $A=\varinjlim_\lambda A_\lambda$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit].

split_report.summary: Tag 0A0P confirmed (tags line 12642, limits.tex line 3346). Stacks' proof: 09ZR (X closed in proper finitely presented X_k), absolute Noetherian approximation 01ZA, descent of finitely presented X_k by 01ZM, properness by 081F, transition morphisms by 01ZM, 'some details omitted'. The caution of the brief is right and Stacks handles it exactly so: X itself is not descended (not of finite presentation), only the finitely presented proper envelopes X_k. The omitted details (a compatible choice of descents indexed by pairs (k,j)) are replaced by an agent-written construction from one envelope Y=X_{k0}: descend Y to a proper Y_j0 over S_j0 and take Z_j = scheme-theoretic image of X in Y_j; the transitions are forced by the universal property, and X = lim Z_j by an affine-local colimit computation. Nine steps; new nodes: lem-weil-pbc-proper-closed-in-proper-fp (09ZR, unsplit), lem-weil-pbc-eventually-proper (081F, unsplit), lem-weil-pbc-scheme-image-qc-kernel (Mathlib leaf, Scheme.Hom.image/ker_apply/IsClosedImmersion.lift). 01ZA and its affine case are the closed nodes prop-nagata-noetherian-inverse-system and lemma-nagata-noetherian-inverse-system-affine (cofiltered category re-indexed by the reviewed leaf lem-weil-pbc-cofiltered-limit-directed-reindex); 01ZM is thm-pd-spreading-out. The affine clause comes from using the finitely generated subrings in step 2.
